roster.name: RDML (Real-time PCR Data Markup Language)
roster.description: An XML-based data-exchange standard for quantitative PCR (qPCR) data that captures experimental setup, assay and instrument metadata, raw and processed qPCR data to allow re-analysis and interpretation. Seed material describes it as a universal structured format (versions 1.0–1.3), mentions an online file generator and validator, a reference implementation (RDML-Ninja), and vendor/third-party support.
